name: Internal Combustion Engines
summary: How reciprocating engines work and are designed: cycles, performance, air and fuel systems, combustion, emissions and boosting.

topics.name: Engine types, operating cycles and geometry
Performance parameters: IMEP, BMEP, efficiencies and specific fuel consumption
Ideal and real engine cycles; fuel-air cycle analysis
Air intake, volumetric efficiency and valve timing
Fuel systems: port and direct injection
Spark-ignition combustion, knock and octane rating
Heat transfer, friction and lubrication in engines
Emissions formation and aftertreatment (catalysts, particulate filters, SCR)
Advanced combustion modes and alternative fuels, including hydrogen engines
Hybridisation and the future of the combustion engine
Small engines for portable power and range extenders
